name: Reversi
description: Reversi (Othello) for a touch screen: tap a square to place a disc and turn every line of the other color it closes in; whoever holds the most discs when the board fills wins. Play the computer (easy, medium or hard: it weighs corners and edges and how many moves each side has left) or a friend on the same frame, as black or white. The squares you may play show as dots (a setting), the last disc played is marked, a player without a move passes by itself, and undo takes you back to your last turn. Back undoes and forward starts a new game on frames with buttons. On black-and-white panels it plays in high contrast; the Contrast setting picks it anywhere.
